newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Two Sri Lankans believed killed in haj fire.
newsitem.headline: Two Sri Lankans believed killed in haj fire.

text.p: Two Sri Lankans are believed to be among at least 217 Moslem pilgrims killed in the fire at the sacred haj ritual in Mena, Saudi Arabia, the Foreign Ministry said on Wednesday.
Sri Lanka's envoy in the kingdom visited Mena soon after the fire and was awaiting confirmation of the deaths and the identities of the victims, the ministry said in a statement.
Tuesday's blaze swept through 70,000 white tents in the Mena plain, 11 km (7 miles) from Mecca. Riyadh said 217 people died and over 1,290 were injured.
